editorial:
Ever wondered what would happen if the fate of the entire world depended on a bike race? You get exactly that in this wild ride. You follow Nash, a young cyclist who is just trying to make a name for himself, but suddenly finds himself in the middle of an alien invasion. Instead of a giant war with lasers and explosions, the aliens decide to settle things with a sporting event. It is a goofy, high-energy setup that feels like a Saturday morning cartoon come to life. The vibe is lighthearted and silly, making it the perfect pick for a lazy weekend when you just want to turn your brain off and have a laugh.

What really makes this stand out is the interactive element, which lets you feel like you are in control of the action. The pacing is snappy, and while the special effects look a bit dated now, they actually add to the charm. If you enjoy cheesy 90s movies with a heart of gold, you will love this. For the best experience, you should try to find it on a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection, or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final stretch of the race, Nash uses every bit of his strength and skill to outpace the alien competitor. He crosses the finish line just in time, winning the race and saving Earth from being taken over. The aliens are surprisingly good sports about losing and head back to their own planet. The movie wraps up with Nash becoming a local hero and finally getting the respect he deserved as a cyclist.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky 90s nostalgia and lighthearted sci-fi.
